mathematical_contract.authority: an exact rational materialization delegates to RationalBezier2's existing shared-component replay and returns its oriented parameter ranges
mathematical_contract.overlap_evidence: BezierParallelIntersectionContacts2::Overlap reuses RationalBezierIntersectionOverlap2; its first range is the analytic-parallel parameter and its second range is the rational operand parameter
mathematical_contract.zero_distance: the analytic parallel is exactly its authored rationalized source even when the source is non-PH or stationary
mathematical_contract.nonzero_distance: only a certified polynomial-square homogeneous hodograph materializes a rational selected parallel
mathematical_contract.branch_selection: the rational materialization represents the authored signed parallel, so an identically degenerate squared equation caused solely by the opposite normal branch can resolve to NoIntersection
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT caches only a result constructed by the strict proof path
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 first attempts the strict construction and may decide only at inherited 512-bit terminals; an approximate-only materialization is never entered into the certified cache and cannot answer a later STRICT call
mathematical_contract.unresolved: a nonzero non-PH degenerate system remains DegenerateResultant for exact bivariate common-factor classification rather than being guessed

implementation.reuse: the parallel contact result maps the authoritative rational NoIntersection, Contacts, Overlap, Incomplete, and DegenerateResultant outcomes without a second overlap representation or compatibility layer
implementation.cache: one clone-shared lazy slot retains only certified PH results behind an Arc; clones retain the one-word BezierParallel2 handle and repeated contact replay does not rebuild the rational carrier
implementation.candidate_fast_path: a retained certified rational parallel delegates candidate construction directly
implementation.degenerate_fast_path: the second elimination direction is skipped once the first resultant is identically zero
implementation.rational_fast_path: same or reversed projective control nets are recognized before generic rational resultant construction
implementation.tests: full/partial/reversed line overlap, selected/opposite branches, independently constructed PH geometry, zero-distance non-PH geometry, both policies, and approximate-cache isolation
